title: A latent step you can swap: two-hop recall in Qwen3-4B through transcoder features
why: Lesions and activation maps show that parts matter, not how understanding composes. Transcoders replace each MLP with sparse features so a single answer can be traced as a graph through attention. The test of 'latent understanding' is an intermediate the model never writes (the state, for a city) that, when swapped, changes the answer the way the concept should.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-4B with mwhanna/qwen3-4b-transcoders (per-layer transcoders, circuit-tracer, TransformerLens backend, bf16)

prompts.P_dallas: Fact: the capital of the state containing Dallas is
prompts.P_sf: Fact: the capital of the state containing San Francisco is
prompts.P_texas: Fact: the capital of Texas is
prompts.P_calif: Fact: the capital of California is

design.baseline: plain completion (no chat template); P_dallas must put ' Austin' top-1 and P_sf ' Sacramento' top-1, else the run stops and reports that
design.graph: circuit_tracer.attribute on P_dallas and P_sf (max_feature_nodes 7500); report the share of total influence on the target logit carried by error nodes (how much the replacement does not explain)
design.texas_features: T = features active in P_dallas at any position after 'Dallas' AND active in P_texas at the ' Texas' token AND not active in P_sf; ranked by their influence on ' Austin' in the P_dallas graph; top 10
design.california_features: C = the same construction from P_sf / P_calif / P_dallas; top 10
design.ablate: set T to 0 at their positions in P_dallas (feature_intervention, attention frozen)
design.swap: set T to 0 and set C to their P_sf activation values at the matching positions in P_dallas
design.control: zero 10 random active features from the same layers with similar activation (20 draws)

hypotheses.H1: Ablating T lowers P(' Austin') in P_dallas by >= 50% (relative); random-feature ablation lowers it by < 20% on average.
hypotheses.H2: Swapping T for C makes ' Sacramento' the top-1 next token of P_dallas.
hypotheses.H3: Exploratory, no prediction: the share of influence through error nodes, and where in depth T sits.

decision_rule: Sets T and C are built by the fixed rule above, before any intervention is run. Results reported whatever they show.
